sourceIssues.detail: Japanese and effective premises do not establish speaker gender. Hindi masculine forms and Thai ผม/ครับ occur; Khmer បាទ and Burmese ကျွန်တော် occur in some exchanges. Existing grammatical gender has not been recast into an invented profile; a corpus speaker-profile policy remains needed. NativeReviewed remains false.

Hint explicitly includes retaining the original receipt, whereas final player response mentions checking meaning and sharing only necessary contents; NPC09 supplies retention instruction. Japanese retained.

Japanese 子供 and premise establish an adult helping a child, without explicit parent relationship. Several targets use my child/con/anak ko/ลูก. Relationship not rewritten by guess; needs source/profile clarification.

reviewCriteria: Preserve unresolved eight/nine time discrepancy, clock provenance and view/note/save chronology without rewriting records.
Match each of three postal receipts to its addressee, sequence and private marks.
Bank acceptance is not completion; share only needed date/amount while preserving original receipt.
Yesterday discount is not today guarantee; labels apply to each individual item.
Select three dry leaves, one green and two brown; test layout before gluing; consult staff for leftovers. No child age is established.
Ambiguous usual-person pickup is insufficient; call owner, keep belongings, return only to owner and leave information entrance clear.
Restore the child's actual old-road question; request diagrams without asserting that an answer is established.
Preserve old medication record with stopped Friday date, previous-appointment instruction and two current medicines in a separate list section; no new medical advice.
Child corrects ambiguous bike/walking wording; distinguish permission to read the question from permission to read the name.
Check outbound and return postage separately, use same-size sheet as weight estimate only, confirm return contents before stamps and seal outer envelope after preparation.
